name: worldview

scripts.db:apply: for f in db/schema/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f"; done

//overrides: Pin one @deck.gl/core (so @deck.gl/react + @deck.gl/layers share a Layer class) and lock the luma.gl stack to the 9.0.x line deck 9.0.27 was built against (^9.0.15 otherwise floats to 9.3.x, which renamed exports deck imports). @deck.gl/extensions + @deck.gl/mesh-layers are transitive (^9.0.0) and must match core too: the deckExtensionsShim aliases ClipExtension from @deck.gl/extensions against the pinned core, so an unpinned extensions copy hoisting to 9.3.x would mismatch the 9.0.27 Layer class.
